area: the fully on-chain token, renderer and engine: src/Ipseity.sol, src/Engine.sol, src/Renderer.sol, src/Sigil.sol, src/lib/*, engine/ipseity.html, tools/build-engine.mjs (+ verify/gas/selftest/glsl-check tooling and test/Ipseity.t.sol)
summary:
IPSEITY is an ERC-721 whose tokenURI returns its own control surface: Ipseity.sol (hub, 1,145 lines, 18,718 B deployed = 76% of EIP-170) stores one 256-bit 'section word' per token plus counters, two ERC-6551 accounts at two salts (an acting Reach and a receive-only Grip), ERC-4907 lending with a separate narrow 'lease agent' power, ERC-5192/6454 soulbinding behind an owner-only bolt, an ERC-7857-inspired sealed kernel whose staleness is derived at read time, ERC-2981 royalties capped at 10%, two-step ERC-173, and 13 asserted ERC-165 ids (165/721/721Metadata/721Enumerable/2981/4906/4907/5192/6454/7572/7160/7496/173). Rendering is delegated through a sealable IRenderer pointer: Renderer.sol (20,747 B, 84%) builds a TokenView-driven JSON with three ERC-7160 faces, and for face 0 concatenates Engine.sol's SSTORE2 head shards + an injected <script>window.IPSE={...}</script> state block + gzip body shards wrapped in a DecompressionStream loader that deliberately declares no global; Sigil.sol (14,477 B) is a Solidity fixed-point 4-D projector that draws the still SVG face. Everything in src/lib is hand-rolled with zero external imports: SSTORE2 (with the CODECOPY-offset bug fixed), a one-mstore-per-group Base64, Trig (six Taylor terms after a measured 3.5 ppm drift), the anchored-virtual-reserve Curve, Uniswap v3/v4 math (Tick, Mul, Hook) reproduced, a 7-day Timelock, Web (HTML/JSON whitelist escaping plus staticcall-tolerant ERC-20 reads), LibNum and Assets.

engine/ipseity.html (200,014 B raw today; README's last build: 173,261 -> 113,379 minified -> 39,501 gzip in 3 shards) is one dependency-free document: a WebGL2 raymarcher of eight 4-D solids, and a complete wallet client — its own keccak-256, ABI coder, EIP-55, EIP-712 hasher, EIP-6963 provider discovery, JSON-RPC transport with an opaque-origin fallback, CREATE2 re-derivation of both ERC-6551 addresses, and a propose/estimateGas/sign/watch pipeline that shows every calldata word before anything is signed. It reads window.IPSE (id, collection, chainId, owner, account, grip, reachImpl, gripImpl, pool, seed, word, rot[6], w, form, hue, ops, strata, xfers, open, locked, block, depth, rpc) and offers twelve 'instruments' (Self, Rotate, Section, Send, Assets, Call, Sign, Scan, Vault, Issue, Market, Nest) gated by an on-chain bitmask (BORN_OPEN = 0x987, paid permanent unlock via openNode). tools/build-engine.mjs minifies (terser, reserved ['IPSE']), gzips, shards at 20,000 B and refuses to build on shader errors, a baked-in state block, or a nest iframe without sandbox='allow-scripts'.

Web UI delivery is entirely from chain in three equivalent forms: (1) tokenURI -> base64 JSON -> base64 HTML animation_url (~104 KB, ~20M gas, opaque origin so no wallet injects — 'looked at, not used'); (2) Premises /token/<id>/live over ERC-5219 web3:// returning the identical Renderer.document() bytes on a real origin for 4.48M gas so EIP-6963 wallets inject and every instrument can sign; (3) the Nest instrument re-fetching tokenURI by eth_call into a sandboxed iframe. Ownership is not a viewing gate: anyone can open the page read-only through a public RPC. Writes are gated client-side by needOwner() (connected EIP-55 account == S.owner, refreshed live via ownerOf eth_call) and enforced on chain by onlyOwner/onlyHolder/onlyOperator or strict-owner checks, with eth_estimateGas showing 'would revert' before the wallet is asked; the Reach's ERC-1271 isValidSignature over an IPSEITY_ATTESTATION typed digest is the available prove-you-control-this-token primitive.

The repo is heavily tested on an in-process EVM (verify.mjs byte-for-byte round trip, gas.mjs against real eth_call caps, selftest.mjs against published crypto vectors, 42 Solidity tests in test/Ipseity.t.sol run by tools/forge.mjs since Foundry is uninstallable) and deployed on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia. Load-bearing comments record every shipped bug: BORN_OPEN 0x587, document.open() global collision, SSTORE2 offset, '<' in an SVG label, free clones, approval-liftable bolt, forgeable lastOp, derived-per-trade curve extraction, tokenURIs at 55M gas. Known limits: tokenURI at ~20M gas does not fit the EIP-7825 16.7M cap, no kernel verifier exists, curator is an EOA, and docs drift (five chains vs Ethereum-only, 137 KB vs 200 KB, 158 vs 135 tests, DEPLOYMENTS.md vs deployments/*.json).

components.name: Ipseity (hub)
components.purpose: The ERC-721: identity, the mutable section word, op/strata/transfer counters, born-open instrument bitmask, two ERC-6551 hands (Reach + Grip), ERC-4907 lending + lease agent, ERC-5192/6454 bolt, ERC-7857-style sealed kernel, ERC-2981 royalties, ERC-7160 faces, ERC-7496 traits, two-step ERC-173 curation, chain-band issuance.
key_functions: mint()/mintTo(address) payable -> uint256 (:352/:356); _issue draws seed = keccak(blockhash(n-1), prevrandao, timestamp, sender, this, id) and packs the word
commit(uint256 id, uint256 word) onlyOperator (:409) — Section.valid or BadSection; emits Committed, MetadataUpdate, TraitUpdated(solid/hue)
openNode(uint256 id, uint8 node) payable onlyHolder nonReentrant (:422) — permanent bit, openFee 0.002 ETH
embody(uint256)/embodyGrip(uint256) -> address (:446/:480) — REGISTRY.createAccount(impl, salt, chainid, this, id); embody never bumps lastOp
setUser onlyHolder (:616); setLeaseAgent strict owner (:657); setUserVia only agent (:665); userOf/userExpires/rawUserOf
lock/unlock onlyOwner (owner or token's own Reach) (:691/:697); locked; isTransferable refuses to==0, to==account(id), to==grip(id), or locked (:712)

setVerifier once-from-zero (:761); sealKernel onlyHolder (:770); transferWithKernel (:787); cloneWithKernel payable strict owner (:821); authorizeUsage strict owner (:865); usageAuthorised epoch-scoped (:878); kernelStatus 0/1/2 derived from sealedOwner==ownerOf (:915); kernelProved; hasVerifier
royaltyInfo via Mul.mulDiv (:937); ERC-721 core incl. Enumerable (:945-:1046); transferFrom clears user, leaseAgent, bumps xfers and _ownerEpoch

setPool/setRenderer (refuse after seal), sealRenderer one-way, setPricing, setRoyalty (<=1000 bps), owner/transferOwnership/acceptOwnership/renounceOwnership, withdraw, supportsInterface (:1048-:1138)
design_decisions: Reach + Grip: 'The point is not that the Grip is guarded better than the Reach; it is that the Grip has nothing to guard, because the capability to spend was never written.'
ACCOUNT_IMPL immutable because 'a mutable implementation would mean a mutable vault address.'

No bridging: the 6551 address derives from block.chainid and address(this): 'A token that crossed would arrive with correct artwork and empty hands.' Edition partitioned into per-chain bands fixed in the constructor (BadBand on firstId==0, lastId<firstId, lastId>4096).
BORN_OPEN = 0x987 (Self, Rotate, Section, Scan, Vault, Nest); the comment records the 0x587 bug where 'every token shipped with the money panel open and the holder was charged to unlock a picture.'
embody does not stamp lastOp: 'anything reading lastOp as a sign of life could be fed one by a stranger for the price of gas.'
Lease agent is a separate narrow power because an ERC-721 approval 'carries transferFrom with it'; cleared on transfer with the user.
Verifier set once, never rotated: 'A rotatable verifier is not a verifier.' Left zero in every deployment so transferWithKernel/cloneWithKernel refuse on a live kernel.
cloneWithKernel costs price: 'an adversarial review pulled eight free tokens out of a single mint'.
Kernel staleness derived at read time: 'The only half of that comparison a seller controls is the one that has already moved.' CURRENT and PROVED deliberately separate.
Two-step ERC-173: 'a mistyped address is accepted, emitted, and irreversible.'
_check hands the verifier tokenId and recipient from call context so a proof cannot be replayed for another token or recipient.
security_invariants: Every token is born renderable (form<8, bits>=128 zero); only a renderable section can be committed
locked() and isTransferable() never disagree (one flag); a bound token does not move
A lease and the lease agent never survive a sale; usage grants die with _ownerEpoch
The bolt (lock/unlock) answers to the owner or the token's own Reach only — never an approvee
A token cannot be transferred to its own Reach or Grip (would be frozen forever)
No instrument that moves value is born open (0x987)
A clone costs what it consumes (price)
Two chains cannot issue the same number (bands)
Royalty <= 10% forever; renderer and pool pointers fixed after sealRenderer
standards: ERC-7857 in spirit only (explicitly not claimed)
components.reuse_notes: The multi-standard hub + two-salt 6551 + lease agent + epoch-scoped grants + two-step ownership is the right skeleton for the unified token and is already 76% of EIP-170, so the unified design must keep the hub/satellite split (hub holds state and viewOf(); Pool/Parley/Lease/Premises hold behaviour). Replace the 4-D section word with the unified state word; treat openNode and the kernel as optional modules; put the curator behind lib/Timelock.

components.name: Engine (document as bytecode)
components.purpose: Freeze-once SSTORE2 shard store holding the HTML document in two runs (head, body) with a gap into which tokenURI writes each token's state; optional gzip mode.
design_decisions: 'tokenURI() writes each token's live state into that gap, so the state arrives before the engine's first line runs and no contract ever has to search a string for a marker.'
Compression: 'every byte costs 200 gas to deposit and inflates the base64 that comes back out of tokenURI()'; packed load 8.86M vs 23.58M raw.
security_invariants: A frozen engine never changes again (test_engine_frozenIsForever, verify.mjs)
components.reuse_notes: 2,724 B deployed, generic, no art coupling. Use as the unified app's document store; other site assets already use separate SSTORE2 stores via tools/site.mjs.

components.name: Renderer
components.purpose: Builds everything a marketplace is handed: three ERC-7160 faces (instrument HTML, still SVG, quartet SVG), the JSON with attributes, the ERC-7572 collection URI, the ERC-7496 trait schema; document() is the exact page bytes Premises /live serves.
key_functions: document(TokenView) -> bytes (head + state + body, or head + self.$IPSE=[state,b64gzip] + INFLATE loader)
_quote escapes " \ and < (-> \x3c) for the compressed path
_json/_attributes (Solid, Notation, Turned through w, Hue, Section w, Strata, Operations, Transfers, Nodes open/12, Reach, Grip, Bound, Kernel none/current/stale)
design_decisions: INFLATE loader declares nothing global: 'document.open() clears the document but keeps the Window ... a const D here and a const D anywhere at the top level of the document being written are the same binding, and the write throws before a pixel is drawn.' Payload crosses on self.$IPSE and is deleted after reading.
Face 1 exists because 'face 0 is a quarter of a megabyte of base64 and some clients will not touch that. A token that becomes invisible when a client is cautious is not really on chain.'
Kernel attribute says none/current/stale because 'sealed would have been a lie on a kernel the token has already outrun'.
security_invariants: The document that comes back is byte-for-byte the document that went in (verify.mjs)
The loader declares nothing in global scope
Every label written into SVG/JSON is data in both formats
Every read fits under the 50M eth_call cap (gas.mjs)
components.reuse_notes: document()/_state/_quote/INFLATE and the tokenURIAt face pattern are the 'NFT mints a website' mechanism — lift whole. Replace description, attributes, trait schema and sigil faces. At 84% of EIP-170 any richer state block needs a companion contract.

components.name: Sigil (on-chain 4-D projector)
components.purpose: Draws the whole 4-polytope as SVG path data in 1e9 fixed point: six Givens rotations, w-divide perspective, three-quarter view; eight forms (tesseract, 16-cell, 24-cell, duocylinder, Clifford torus, tiger, ditorus, quaternion Julia) and four elevations (quartet).
design_decisions: _turn written out with locals: the nested memory array literal 'was rebuilt on every call ... came to roughly half the gas of drawing the whole solid' (-6.6M on tokenURIs)
Swept forms hoist 25 cos/sin pairs: 'four hundred series evaluations to produce fifty distinct numbers' (-4.8M)
SCHLAFLI notation uses unicode arrow because 'z<-z2+c' made 'the eighth solid's image ... not an SVG at all'
security_invariants: Every solid projects to non-empty geometry; four elevations differ; SVG root well-formed (fuzz); labels contain no <&"\
components.reuse_notes: Art-specific. Keep the techniques: a cheap on-chain SVG face every cautious client can show, label scanning in the suite, and the memory-literal/hoisting gas lessons.

components.name: SSTORE2
components.purpose: Bytes as contract code: write() deploys 61<len+1> 80 600c 6000 39 6000 f3 00 <data>; read() via extcodecopy from offset 1; MAX_SHARD 24,575.
design_decisions: 'The PUSH1 at offset 4 is the CODECOPY source offset, and it must be 12 ... Get it wrong by two and every shard comes back with the tail of the init code glued to its front' — the reference implementation carries that bug; the first byte is STOP so a CALL halts.
security_invariants: read(write(x)) == x for any 0 < |x| <= 24,575; runtime begins with STOP (test_sstore2_roundTripsExactly, testFuzz_sstore2_roundTrips)

components.name: Base64
components.purpose: Assembly base64 encoder on tokenURI's return path: one mstore(shl(224,o)) per 4-char group, +32 slack allocation.
design_decisions: Four mstore8 replaced by one shifted mstore saved 6.6M gas on tokenURIs; 'This loop runs once per three bytes of a document measured in tens of kilobytes.'
components.reuse_notes: Hot path for any data: URI.

components.name: Section + TokenView
components.purpose: Section: bit layout of the one-slot state word (angles 0-95, w 96-111, solid 112-119, hue 120-127) with angle/offsetW/form/hue/valid/pack. TokenView: the 18-field struct the hub gathers once so the renderer never calls back.
key_functions: struct TokenView{id, word, seed, owner, collection, boundAccount, grip, reachImpl, gripImpl, pool, ops, strata, xfers, open, mintBlock, locked, kernel}
design_decisions: reachImpl/gripImpl are passed 'so the instrument can re-derive both addresses by CREATE2 rather than take this contract's word for them'
kernel is uint8 not bool because 'there is a kernel' and 'it is sealed to whoever holds this token' are different facts
security_invariants: The section word round-trips (testFuzz_sectionWord_roundTrips)
components.reuse_notes: Keep the TokenView gather-once pattern and the one-slot packed state idea; replace Section's fields with the unified token's state.

components.name: Trig
components.purpose: sin/cos in 1e9 fixed point, quadrant folding, Taylor to x^13.
design_decisions: 'Four left sin(pi/2) reading 1.000003543 ... The test asserting 1e9 +/- 200 had never been executed'; six terms hold 3e-9; sin^2+cos^2 drift 7 ppb.
security_invariants: The rotation is orthonormal (test_trig, testFuzz_pythagorean)
components.reuse_notes: Only needed if a geometric art face is retained; then reuse verbatim.

components.name: Curve (per-token AMM invariant)
components.purpose: (x+vx)(y+vy)=k with virtual reserves derived from the section plane (cutDirection closed form, measured SLICE/FALLOFF tables, deviation from rest), anchored on liquidity/curve changes and never per trade; amountOut rounds toward the pool; MAX_CONCENTRATION 8x.
key_functions: amountOut(amountIn, rIn, rOut, vIn, vOut, feeBps)
design_decisions: 'ANCHORING, not deriving ... It used to be called on every quote, from the live reserves, and that was a critical bug ... 400 units in came back as 718. The fuzz suite found it.'
Old sum-of-angles rule 'was a control that lied': angles (pi,pi,0) render untouched while the market sat at two-thirds concentration.
Virtual reserves cannot guarantee the pool can pay — fixed by MAX_OUT_BPS in Pool, 'The pool has a maximum trade size, and says so.'
security_invariants: A round trip never profits (fuzz.mjs)
Rounding always toward the pool
The same cut always prices the same
components.reuse_notes: Anchored virtual reserves, rounding rules and the max-out cap are the swap core; the SLICE/FALLOFF art tables should be replaced by whatever the unified token's state means for concentration (or a plain constant).

components.name: Tick / Mul / Hook (Uniswap math without imports)
components.purpose: Tick: v3 TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick (19 constants), spacing, usable (round-to-nearest), meanTick (toward -inf). Mul: Remco Bloemen mulDiv + priceFromSqrt. Hook: v4 hook permission bits read from the address, DYNAMIC_FEE/OVERRIDE_FEE flags, CREATE2 at().
design_decisions: 'Approximate to choose, exact to display.'
'A hook cannot claim not to intercept swaps while having the swap bit set, because the bit is what makes the interception happen.'
security_invariants: sqrtAt rounds up so the pool's inverse lands on the same tick
mulDiv exact (test/Mul.t.sol)
components.reuse_notes: Dependency-free launchpad/swap math; needed for any Uniswap v3/v4 integration in the unified launchpad.

components.name: Timelock
components.purpose: 7-day delay, 14-day grace, queue/execute/cancel, admin rotation only through its own queue, refuses re-queue.
design_decisions: 'One admin, one delay, one public queue.' No roles, guardians or veto council — 'Every one of those is another key to steal.'
security_invariants: The admin cannot escape the delay; a queued op expires
components.reuse_notes: Put the unified hub's curator behind it (MAINNET_READINESS gate).

components.name: Web + LibNum + Assets
components.purpose: Web: HTML/JSON whitelist escaping, staticcall-tolerant symbol/name/decimals with gas stipends and bytes32 tolerance, amount formatting. LibNum: str/strInt/hexAddr/hex32/fixed1. Assets: token list derived from the pool's open markets.
design_decisions: Whitelist not blacklist: '/token/<id>/live serves the instrument on this same origin ... A script injected through a market page is same-origin with a live wallet client.'
Offset checked before any mload: 'one hostile ERC-20 in one market took every page that listed it out of gas'.
Token list 'Derived ... An asset is on this list because a market in this collection trades it.'
security_invariants: Nothing a stranger chose can become markup on a page
components.reuse_notes: Mandatory for any contract that emits HTML/JSON containing chain strings.

components.name: ipseity.html — chain + signing half (sections 7-9)
components.purpose: Dependency-free wallet client carried inside the token: keccak-256 (BigInt lanes), EIP-55, ABI encoder/decoder, encodeCall from a human signature, EIP-712 typeHash/hashStruct/domainSeparator/digest712, EIP-6963 discovery keyed by rdns with legacy fallback, JSON-RPC transport (provider or public endpoint, credentials omitted), connect/requireChain (switch/add chain), propose (plain sentence + every calldata word decoded + eth_estimateGas 'would revert') / fire (125% gas) / watch (receipt polling), CREATE2 re-derivation of both ERC-6551 accounts (ERC-1167 initcode + registry), SANDBOXED detection via localStorage throw, packSection/unpackSection.
design_decisions: 'A page that has to ask a library what a selector is cannot honestly claim to be on chain.'
'No transaction leaves this page until the calldata that will be sent has been rebuilt from the signature, split into words, priced, and put in front of you in a sentence.'
Boot checks keccak('') == 0xc5d2...a470 before offering to sign.
Storage throwing 'is the cheapest reliable way to tell that this document is running inside someone else's frame.'
Opaque-origin RPC uses credentials:'omit' because Origin is null.
security_invariants: The token's own cryptography agrees with Ethereum (tools/selftest.mjs: keccak, selectors, EIP-55, ABI, EIP-712 Mail vector, CREATE2)
Derived 6551 addresses agree with the contract's (agrees())
components.reuse_notes: Lift as the unified app's wallet library (~600 lines); only the CHAINS table and module-specific plain-English strings change.

components.name: ipseity.html — instrument scaffolding and panels (sections 0, 5, 10-14)
components.purpose: MODULES[12] with on-chain open bitmask, the plate for sealed nodes (openNode tx), the sheet panel builder, needWallet/needOwner guards, BUILD.* panels (Self, Rotate, Section, Send, Assets, Call, Sign incl. ERC-1271 vault attestation, Scan, Vault incl. embody/seal/manifest/execute/executeBatch/grantSession/revokeSession/send-to-Grip, Issue, Market incl. openMarket/quote/swap minOut+deadline/bond/deposit/withdraw/syncCurve, Nest), refresh() reading ownerOf/sectionOf/statsOf, command palette with /connect that leaves to /c/<id>, DOORED origin detection.
design_decisions: The in-page 'deck' of contract pages was removed: two documents each raymarching on one phone thread — 'It was becoming a browser with a picture in it.' A node opens its own control; everything else is reached by leaving.
A sealed node answers where it was tapped (the plate) and the cost is stated before the button.
Nest iframe is sandbox='allow-scripts' only (cb0767c) and MAX_DEPTH 3 because browsers drop WebGL contexts silently past 8-16.
security_invariants: needOwner compares the connected EIP-55 account with S.owner refreshed from ownerOf
All chain strings reach the DOM via esc() or textContent; attestation digest validated as bytes32 before rendering (42dc541)
components.reuse_notes: The module/plate/sheet/palette scaffolding is the template for the four GOAL instruments; the Market and Vault panels are already a swap and a vault UI. Messaging and launchpad panels would be new BUILD.* entries driven by Parley/Kiln calldata, re-using encodeCall/propose.

components.name: ipseity.html — WebGL2 4-D field (sections 1-6)
components.purpose: Raymarcher of eight 4-D signed-distance solids sectioned by a 3-plane, temporal accumulator, Kawase bloom, ACES composite, quality ladder with handheld/reduced-motion ceilings, idle and nest throttles, context-loss recovery, orbit/pinch/plane-chip input.
key_functions: FS_FIELD (sdTesseract/sdCrossPolytope/sd24Cell/sdDuocylinder/sdCliffordTorus/sdTiger/sdDitorus/sdJulia, map, grad3, leanW, shadow, ao)
design_decisions: Quality ladder has a ceiling on handhelds: 'it optimises for frames and pays in watts'
Idle throttle to 10 Hz after 96 converged frames; host yields to the nested copy at 5 Hz
Canvas sized by calc, not insets: 'laid out an 1180x860 field as 2x2 and drew nothing'
security_invariants: Every shader compiles (tools/glsl-check.mjs enforced in build)
The document the chain returns draws (tools/shots.mjs)
components.reuse_notes: Roughly 60% of the document bytes and the whole gas budget; not required by the GOAL. If an animated face is wanted, keep the ladder/throttle/context-loss code and swap the SDFs.

components.name: build-engine + verification tooling
components.path: tools/build-engine.mjs, tools/glsl-check.mjs, tools/selftest.mjs, tools/verify.mjs, tools/gas.mjs, tools/shots.mjs
components.purpose: Minify (terser, reserved ['IPSE']), gzip level 9, shard at 20,000 B into dist/shards.json + dist/ipseity.min.html; refuse on shader errors, baked state, missing nest sandbox; verify.mjs deploys on an in-process EVM and round-trips tokenURI byte-for-byte; gas.mjs measures every read against 10/30/50/100M caps and fails above 50M; selftest.mjs checks the engine's crypto against published vectors; shots.mjs opens the returned document in Chromium.
key_functions: PROLOGUE plain head for packed mode
verify.mjs: loader-declares-nothing regex, born-open derived from a named list
gas.mjs: measure() via vm.evm.runCall with 3e9 gas limit
design_decisions: Function replacements because minified code contains '$1' and a string replacement 'would expand that against this regex, splicing the original unminified script back in.'
'A shader is a string until a GPU touches it, so nothing else in this pipeline can tell a working one from a broken one.'
Gas measured on the call, not a transaction, 'because eth_call is what a wallet actually issues'.
security_invariants: Document round-trips byte-for-byte
No global in loader
All reads under 50M
Engine crypto matches Ethereum
components.reuse_notes: Each guard encodes a shipped bug; add the unified app's survive-by-name globals to reserved.

standards_implemented: ERC-6551 (canonical registry, two accounts at two salts)
ERC-7857 — explicitly NOT claimed (sealed kernel under its own name)
EIP-6963 / EIP-1193 wallet discovery and transport
EIP-170 size discipline, EIP-2028 calldata pricing, EIP-7825 tx cap awareness
Uniswap v3 TickMath/FullMath and v4 Hooks reproduced without imports
unique_ideas: State injected into a gap between head and body SSTORE2 shards; the engine reads window.IPSE and no contract ever searches a string
gzip shards inflated by the browser's DecompressionStream; the loader passes the payload on a deleted property and declares no global (document.open() keeps the Window)
Three ERC-7160 faces with a cheap SVG face plus tokenURIAt so a cautious client never has to pull everything
Two ERC-6551 accounts at two salts: an acting, sealable Reach and a receive-only Grip whose guarantee is that no spend function was ever written
The instrument re-derives both CREATE2 addresses and every EIP-712 digest and compares them with the contract; it checks its own keccak at boot
Nothing is signed without showing the bytes: selector, every word decoded, estimateGas result, plain sentence
Kernel staleness derived from sealedOwner != ownerOf with no hook; CURRENT and PROVED kept apart; verifier set once from zero
Lease agent as a narrow power separate from ERC-721 approval; usage grants scoped to an owner epoch; strict-owner for anything that outlives an approval
Born-open vs sealed instruments as an on-chain bitmask with a permanent paid unlock, shown as a 'plate' where the node was tapped
Chain bands partition a 4096 edition without a bridge; the 6551 derivation is the argument against ever bridging
gas.mjs measures every read against the real eth_call caps and fails the build; the ERC-5219 /live route serves identical bytes at a fifth of the gas
Web.esc whitelist + staticcall-tolerant ERC-20 reads with gas stipends and an offset check before any mload
Token list derived from the pool's open markets instead of fetched
Nest: the token opens itself inside itself in a sandboxed iframe, depth-limited by WebGL context counts
Load-bearing comments as changelog: every shipped bug is recorded in past tense next to the code that fixed it
weaknesses: tokenURI() reads at ~20M gas: inside geth's 50M eth_call cap but above the EIP-7825 16,777,216 transaction cap that some nodes apply to eth_call; Premises /live (4.48M) is the mitigation but marketplaces call tokenURI
Renderer is 84% and Ipseity 76% of EIP-170; little room for the GOAL's extra state without more satellites
No kernel verifier exists in any deployment; kernelProved() is false everywhere; resealing cannot make a seller forget
Curator is a single EOA in every record; lib/Timelock exists but is not in front of the hub
needOwner() is stricter than onlyOperator (renters and approvees are refused client-side for commit)

Documentation drift: CLAUDE.md says five chains but BANDS/Nameplate are Ethereum-only; README says 137 KB engine (now 200 KB), 158 vs 135 Solidity tests, references a non-existent Seal.s.sol; DEPLOYMENTS.md 'Live now' addresses differ from deployments/*.json
dist/ is not committed; every verification needs a build first; real forge has never run on this code
Marketplace data: frames cannot sign by design; instruments only work on a web3:// origin or gateway
ERC-721Enumerable gas on every transfer; ERC-5192 and ERC-6454 both registered is an acknowledged smell
IsLocked error declared but unused; setRoyalty reuses BadIndex for its cap
Nest bounded at depth 3 by browser WebGL context limits; the raymarcher heats phones (mitigated by ceilings, not solved)
website_delivery: Entirely from chain, no server, no IPFS. (1) Ipseity.tokenURI(id) returns data:application/json;base64 whose animation_url is data:text/html;base64 = Renderer.document(viewOf(id)) = Engine head shards + injected <script>window.IPSE={...}</script> + a DecompressionStream loader + gzip body shards (~104 KB, ~20M gas to read); this is what marketplaces render, in an opaque-origin frame where no wallet injects. (2) Premises.request('/token/<id>/live') (ERC-5219, src/Premises.sol:509-528) returns the identical Renderer.document() bytes as text/html on a real web3:// origin (e.g. web3://0x01de…b7b1:84532/token/2/live or the w3link gateway) for 4.48M gas, where EIP-6963 discovery works and every instrument can sign; /raw, /face/<n> and /sigil.svg serve the other faces, all answered by Premises itself rather than a replaceable page. (3) The Nest instrument re-fetches tokenURI by eth_call and mounts it in a sandbox='allow-scripts' iframe with depth+1. The flat site (/, /c/<id> console, swap, launch, chat) is served the same way by Premises through immutable page contracts whose JS is Solidity string constants or SSTORE2 stores.
wallet_gating: Viewing is not gated: the page renders for anyone and falls back to read-only through a public RPC when no wallet announces itself (or inside a marketplace frame, detected by localStorage throwing). Writes are gated twice. Client-side, needOwner() (engine/ipseity.html:2585) requires the EIP-6963-connected, EIP-55-checksummed account to equal S.owner, which is injected by the renderer at tokenURI time and refreshed live by refresh() via an ownerOf(id) eth_call; propose() runs eth_estimateGas and shows 'would revert' before the wallet is asked. On chain, every mutation is guarded by Ipseity's modifiers — onlyOwner (owner or the token's own Reach) for lock/unlock, onlyHolder (owner/approved) for openNode/pin/setUser/sealKernel, onlyOperator (plus the live ERC-4907 user) for commit/setTrait, strict msg.sender == owner for setLeaseAgent/authorizeUsage/cloneWithKernel — and by IpseityAccount's own checks for Reach actions. Delegation is on chain too: ERC-721 approvals, ERC-4907 user / leaseAgentOf, bounded grantSession keys on the Reach, epoch-scoped authorizeUsage. There is no sign-in or session; the Reach's ERC-1271 isValidSignature over an IPSEITY_ATTESTATION(string purpose, bytes32 payload) EIP-712 digest is the available 'prove you control this token' primitive for any third-party login.

pitfalls: document.open() keeps the Window: any global binding in a loader collides with a minified engine's single-letter names; the loader must declare nothing and pass the payload on a property
SSTORE2 CODECOPY source offset must equal the init prologue length (12) — the reference implementation is wrong and the corruption reads fine
A bare < or & in a label that lands in SVG, or a " or \ in JSON, breaks the thumbnail everywhere; scan every label in the suite
Assertions that restate a constant (BORN_OPEN 0x587) cannot catch it being wrong; derive expected masks from named lists
Nested memory array literals and un-hoisted trig inside per-point loops cost millions of gas per read; four mstore8 vs one mstore likewise
A Taylor series with four terms is 3.5 ppm off and a test that never executed asserted otherwise
Free clones made the supply cap decorative; onlyHolder on a soulbind bolt let a phished approval lift it; a public embody that bumped lastOp forged a sign of life
A token transferred to its own ERC-6551 account is frozen forever — refuse it in isTransferable, computed not looked up
Nested iframes must not have allow-same-origin; attestation answers must be validated as bytes32 before DOM; opaque-origin fetches must omit credentials
Terser mangles toplevel — list survive-by-name globals in reserved; use function replacements because minified code contains '$1'
tokenURIs() must return every face and silently exceeded the 50M cap; measure every read, do not reason about it
EIP-7825 may make tokenURI unservable on strict nodes; design the ERC-5219 /live route as the primary website path
Deriving virtual reserves per trade re-anchors the curve and leaks reserves (400 in -> 718 out); anchor on liquidity/curve changes only
A hostile ERC-20 answering symbol() with a huge ABI offset is a quadratic-memory DoS against every page listing it; check the offset before any mload and stipend the staticcall
The repo's own numbers drift (byte counts, test counts, chain lists, deployment prose); re-measure before quoting
via_ir is mandatory: the renderer's 100 KB string build and the sigil's rotations run out of stack without it
